Analyst.title: Your work queue
Analyst.body: My Work groups tests assigned to you, unassigned section tests you can take, and reading tasks by urgency.

Analyst.title: My Work in the sidebar
Analyst.body: Use My Work in the navigation menu to return to your queue from any page and see how many tasks are waiting.

Analyst.title: Sample receiving
Analyst.body: Register incoming samples for your laboratory section and print barcode labels from Receive Sample.

Analyst.title: Search MicroLIMS (Ctrl+K)
Analyst.body: Press Ctrl+K or select the search bar to jump to a sample, batch, test order, or controlled document by code.

Analyst.title: Notifications
Analyst.body: Check alerts when incubations are ready to read or when a test is returned to you for revision.

Analyst.title: Help and shortcuts
Analyst.body: Open the user guide chapter for the current page with F1, view keyboard shortcuts with ?, or replay this tour.

Reviewer.title: Technical review queue
Reviewer.body: My Work lists samples waiting for technical verification, document reviews, and reading tasks ordered by urgency.

Reviewer.title: My Work in the sidebar
Reviewer.body: Select My Work in the sidebar to return to your review queue and check the live task count.

Reviewer.title: Document Control
Reviewer.body: Open Document Control to review and approve controlled documents, inspect the training matrix, and read SOPs.

Reviewer.title: Search MicroLIMS (Ctrl+K)
Reviewer.body: Press Ctrl+K or select the search bar to find samples, test orders, or controlled documents by identifier.

Reviewer.title: Notifications
Reviewer.body: Check alerts when samples enter technical review or when controlled documents require your attention.

Reviewer.title: Help and guidance
Reviewer.body: Press F1 for the current page's user guide chapter, press ? for keyboard shortcuts, or replay this tour.

SectionHead.title: Approvals and section queue
SectionHead.body: My Work brings together sample approvals, technical reviews, media and solution releases, and unassigned section work.

SectionHead.title: Tracking Board
SectionHead.body: Open the Tracking Board to follow every received sample and see its current stage across laboratory sections.

SectionHead.title: OOS Tracking
SectionHead.body: Use OOS Tracking to oversee out-of-specification investigations, retest progress, and closure decisions.

SectionHead.title: Search MicroLIMS (Ctrl+K)
SectionHead.body: Press Ctrl+K or select the search bar to locate samples, batches, master data records, or controlled documents.

SectionHead.title: Notifications
SectionHead.body: See alerts for samples awaiting approval, media expiry warnings, and returned test orders.

SectionHead.title: Help and guidance
SectionHead.body: Open the guide chapter for the current page with F1, check keyboard shortcuts with ?, or replay this tour.

QcManager.title: Pending approvals and tasks
QcManager.body: My Work shows not-applicable test requests and document reading tasks waiting for your decision, grouped by urgency.

QcManager.title: Items and specifications
QcManager.body: Open Items to inspect item specifications and record final decisions on not-applicable test requests.

QcManager.title: Reports
QcManager.body: Use Reports to review laboratory performance indicators, turnaround trends, and compliance summaries.

QcManager.title: Search MicroLIMS (Ctrl+K)
QcManager.body: Press Ctrl+K or select the search bar to look up samples, items, or controlled documents from any screen.

QcManager.title: Notifications
QcManager.body: Check alerts for pending approvals, document updates, and discussions.

QcManager.title: Help and guidance
QcManager.body: Press F1 to open the user guide for the current page or replay this tour whenever needed.

Qa.title: Quality Assurance queue
Qa.body: My Work lists document reviews, approvals, and quality tasks waiting for your action, grouped by urgency.

Qa.title: Audit Trail Reviews
Qa.body: Open Audit Trail Reviews to conduct and sign periodic reviews of the GxP audit trail and record findings.

Qa.title: Access Review
Qa.body: Use Access Review to examine periodic user access reports and sign the quality assurance conclusion.

Qa.title: Search MicroLIMS (Ctrl+K)
Qa.body: Press Ctrl+K or select the search bar to search across samples, controlled documents, and laboratory records.

Qa.title: Notifications
Qa.body: Check alerts for document workflow assignments and discussions.

Qa.title: Help and guidance
Qa.body: Press F1 to open the guide chapter for the current page or replay this tour from the Help menu.

SystemAdministrator.title: Administrator tasks
SystemAdministrator.body: My Work displays administrative tasks and assigned document reading items waiting for your action.

SystemAdministrator.title: Users
SystemAdministrator.body: Open Users to create accounts, manage laboratory section memberships, and handle lockouts or password resets.

SystemAdministrator.title: Settings
SystemAdministrator.body: Use Settings to configure password policies, session timeouts, and system operating parameters.

SystemAdministrator.title: Search MicroLIMS (Ctrl+K)
SystemAdministrator.body: Press Ctrl+K or select the search bar to find users, controlled documents, or records across the application.

SystemAdministrator.title: Notifications
SystemAdministrator.body: Check system notifications and discussion updates that need your attention.

SystemAdministrator.title: Help and guidance
SystemAdministrator.body: Press F1 to open the user guide for the current page or replay this tour from the Help menu.

0_1_0: My Work brings your assigned tests, reading tasks, and approvals into one queue grouped by urgency.
Choose visible columns, adjust row density, and save personal or shared table views across registers.
Paste rows from a spreadsheet into receiving and location-count grids and review a preview before filling the form.
Entry forms pre-fill your last chosen equipment and media lot, and ask you to confirm pre-filled lots before saving.
Press F1 or open Help to read the guide chapter for the current page, search the guide, or replay your role tour.
